Eight Detained in Ram Temple Donation Graft Case

Eight individuals have been detained in connection with alleged irregularities in Ram Temple donations. The case involves accusations of financial impropriety, with reports detailing the assets of the accused. Legal proceedings are underway, including the refusal of defense by a bar association for the accused, and the matter has been classified as an economic offense by some.
